description: This file is a Java implementation of a service class named ExternalAssetOwnerLoanProductAttributesWriteServiceImpl for managing external asset owner loan product attributes within the Fineract project. It handles creation and updating of attributes, performs validation, and interacts with repositories and domain objects.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnerLoanProductAttributesWriteServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of service for writing (creating/updating) external asset owner loan product attributes within Fineract.

methods.name: createExternalAssetOwnerLoanProductAttribute
methods.description: Creates a new external asset owner loan product attribute after validation.

methods.name: updateExternalAssetOwnerLoanProductAttribute
methods.description: Updates an existing external asset owner loan product attribute after validation.

methods.name: validateLoanProductAttributeRequest
methods.description: Validates that the API request body contains valid parameters for the attribute.

methods.name: validateLoanProductExistsAndAttributeDoesNotExist
methods.description: Checks the existence of loan product and absence of the attribute for creation validation.

methods.name: validateLoanProductExists
methods.description: Validates that the loan product with the given ID exists.

methods.name: validateLoanProductAttributeDoesNotExist
methods.description: Checks that the attribute does not already exist for the given loan product.

methods.name: validateLoanProductAttributeKeysMatch
methods.description: Ensures the attribute key in request matches the key in database during update.

methods.name: validateExternalAssetOwnerLoanProductAttribute
methods.description: Validates that the attribute key and value are valid according to enum classes.

methods.name: getLoanProductAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a loan product attribute by ID, throws if not found.

methods.name: buildResponseData
methods.description: Builds CommandProcessingResult with the entity's info for response.
